en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a residential neighborhood with clustered houses and inns with pitched roofs, surrounded by greenery and low hills in the background. The foreground shows a vine-covered garden and a small inn building labeled "Gasthaus zum Bachwirt". The upper left corner has printed red text indicating a street name, and the upper right corner names the district and city (Graz–Ruckerlberg). The architecture is early 20th‑century Central European.
